items.source: ContentSelector backed by include/exclude filters.
items.translation: 由 ContentSelector` 支持的 `include`/`exclude` filters。

items.source: ContentFilter that matches Library items based on a coordinates pattern.
items.translation: ContentFilter 根据坐标模式匹配 Library 项。

items.source: ContentFilter that matches application items based on an Ant-style path pattern.
items.translation: 匹配基于 Ant 风格路径模式的 ContentFilter 应用程序项。

items.source: Strategy used by CustomLayers to select the layer of an item.
items.translation: CustomLayers 用于选择项目所在层的策略。

items.source: Custom Layers implementation where layer content is selected by the user.
items.translation: 自定义Layers实现，由用户选择层内容。

items.source: Classes used to support layer customization.
items.translation: 用于支持图层自定义的类。

items.source: Tools for generating executable JAR/WAR files.
items.translation: 用于生成可执行 JAR/WAR 文件的工具。

items.source: Callback interface that can be used to filter layer contents.
items.translation: 可用于过滤图层内容的回调接口。
